message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to a database of train‑station pet‑policy details. However, here’s what I do know:

| Transit Mode | Typical Pet Policy |
|--------------|--------------------|
| **Amtrak** – *Miami Station* (Silver Service/Palmetto) | Small dogs allowed in carriers under $25 ft³; larger animals require special arrangements. No separate “pet‑friendly” designation exists. |
| **Tri-Rail** – *South Dade / North Dade Stations* | Dogs permitted in carriers up to 20 lb; no dedicated pet areas. |
| **Metrorail & Metromover** – all stations | Pets prohibited inside cars/stations. |

If you’re traveling by rail from Miami, it’s safest to check the carrier’s official website or call their customer service line before departure to confirm current rules and any fees associated with bringing your dog aboard.
